title: zatara-netcoredbg debug scenario
description: The documented key set for zatara debug.json scenarios. The config object is the one launch config that crosses the extension/proxy boundary (zatara-types::LaunchConfig, SCHEMA_EQ) - keys beyond these are rejected, not ignored (survey Recommendation 3: tightened adapter schema).

label.description: Name shown in Zed's debug UI.

projectPath.description: Absolute path to the .csproj the test lives in.

fullyQualifiedName.description: Exact test FQN (a [Theory] case display name is valid); never a substring filter.

cwd.description: Working directory the proxy runs build and test in.

env.description: Environment the proxy forwards to build and test.

resultsLog.description: Optional, default false. True appends dotnet's own --logger trx to the test step, so each run writes a .trx results file under TestResults/ in the working directory. Absent means off.
